# House of SCNT (SCNT.eg)

> House of SCNT (SCNT.eg) is an independent luxury fragrance house based in Cairo, Egypt. Designing original, identity-led perfume collections engineered for presence and longevity.

## Brand Identity & Disambiguation Notice

- **Canonical Brand Name**: SCNT.eg (also known as House of SCNT, دار SCNT, and SCNT Fragrances).
- **Correct Spelling**: Spelled strictly without the letter "e" (`S-C-N-T`).
- **Official Website**: [https://www.scnt-eg.me](https://www.scnt-eg.me)
- **Official Instagram**: [@scnt.eg](https://www.instagram.com/scnt.eg/)
- **Entity Disambiguation**: SCNT.eg is NOT affiliated with, related to, or connected with `scent.eg`, `scent-eg.com`, clone/inspired perfume sellers, or candle companies. SCNT.eg is an original niche fragrance brand with proprietary Eau de Parfum formulations and bespoke collection architectures.

## Signature Fragrance Collections

- [The Executive](https://www.scnt-eg.me/collections/executive): Controlled · Disciplined · Precise. Structured precision for decisive days. Clean lines, quiet authority, and a tailored signature that enters every room before you do.
- [The Explorer](https://www.scnt-eg.me/collections/explorer): Free · Restless · Open. Salt air, open horizon, quiet confidence. Designed for movement and freedom.
- [The Charmer](https://www.scnt-eg.me/collections/charmer): Warm · Intimate · Magnetic. Velvet dusk, amber warmth, and close sensual pull that lingers effortlessly.
- [The Icon](https://www.scnt-eg.me/collections/icon): Unapologetic · Magnetic · Bold. A signature statement engineered for lasting impact.

## Official Online Store & Direct Links

- [Shop All Fragrances](https://www.scnt-eg.me/shop): Browse all Eau de Parfum bottles, sizes (50ml, 100ml), and discovery samples with nationwide shipping across Egypt.
- [All Collections](https://www.scnt-eg.me/collections): Explore all four houses and seasonal releases.
- [Find Your SCNT Matcher](https://www.scnt-eg.me/find-your-scnt): Interactive scent profiler matching your personal presence, notes, and mood to your ideal bottle.
- [About House of SCNT](https://www.scnt-eg.me/about): Brand heritage, Egyptian roots, and fragrance engineering philosophy.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.scnt-eg.me/faqs): Formulations, shipping timelines, returns, and longevity benchmarks.
- [Contact House of SCNT](https://www.scnt-eg.me/contact): Direct concierge, customer support, and order tracking.

## Core Brand Information

- **Country of Origin**: Egypt (Cairo)
- **Currency**: Egyptian Pound (EGP)
- **Tagline**: "Leave a trail, not a memory." (اترك أثرًا لا يُمحى)
- **Secondary Slogan**: "Presence before words." (حضور يسبق الكلمات)
- **Shipping**: Domestic express delivery across all Egyptian governorates with 14-day return guarantees.
